p3_scoring_config.system_prompt: You are a decision assistant. Choose exactly one of the listed options. Reply with only its letter.
p3_scoring_config.probability_semantics: T=1 softmax conditional on supplied single-token option symbols; not full-vocabulary confidence or calibrated confidence

disposition: all model/optimizer/RNG state discarded on process exit; no weights saved
